sources.title: EU AI Act consolidated text
sources.reading_status: Articles 28–49, Annexes IV–VIII and XIV read in full from the retained English consolidation. Targeted bridges reread: Article 2(2), Article 6(1)–(5), Article 3 definitions (12), (19)–(25), Articles 8–18, 25, 71, 111(2) and 113. Not a full-law or sector-law audit. Direct consolidation web open timed out; retained source used.

sources.title: Commission AI Act regulatory framework
sources.reading_status: Current overview checked for the July 2026 amendment identity and phased application dates. Article 113 retained text controls section-specific course claims.

sources.title: Commission AI Act standardisation
sources.reading_status: Full page read. Distinguishes voluntary standards, development and Official Journal citation. Does not establish a comprehensive current list of cited AI Act standards.

sources.title: Commission: Understanding standardisation in the AI Act
sources.reading_status: Full FAQ read, including differing ISO 42001 and AI Act QMS objectives, publication and citation process. No universal certification sufficiency inferred.

sources.title: Commission: Notified bodies and NANDO
sources.reading_status: Full page read: qualification, notified tasks, identification numbers and NANDO lookup. Individual current AI Act body entries and scope codes not audited.

sources.title: AI Act Service Desk: Article 49
sources.reading_status: All displayed Article 49 paragraphs checked against the retained consolidation; no national registration portal operation was verified.

sources.title: Cyber Resilience Act Regulation (EU) 2024/2847
sources.reading_status: Official English OJ PDF: Article 2, definitions 3(1)–(2), and Article 12(1)–(4) read. Scope excludes the specified medical-device products; deemed cybersecurity compliance requires product requirements, vulnerability-handling processes and declaration evidence. Paragraphs 2–3 preserve distinct assessment/important-critical-product rules. Remaining CRA, later changes and dates need a case-specific version check; no complete CRA conformity conclusion.

sources.title: Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/745
sources.reading_status: AI Act Annex I and Article 43(3) references read. Fictional case stipulates sector coverage and required third-party assessment; no real medical-device class, sector exemption or complete medical-product conformity conclusion is assigned.

sources.title: Accreditation and market surveillance Regulation (EC) No 765/2008
sources.reading_status: Article 30(1)–(6) read in original and 16 July 2021 consolidated text; responsibility, eligible products, sole conformity marking, misleading-marking prohibition and national enforcement verified. Annex II text checked; no physical-marking artwork audit.
